en.headline: First cohort of dental interns completes year; 46 join Department of Health
en.dek: Of 74 local graduates who finished the mandatory 12-month programme, about 62 percent will take up posts in the public dental service, the Department of Health said.
body: Seventy-four local dental graduates have completed the first mandatory 12-month internship and obtained full registration, the Department of Health said on Friday. Forty-six of them, or about 62 percent, will join the department.

The internship requirement took effect under amendments to the Dentists Registration Ordinance from April 2025. The first cohort of 75 graduates began in September 2025; one internee’s period was extended after an investigation into unauthorised access to patient records.

Interns rotated through general, emergency, hospital, school and community dental services under the Department of Health, the Hospital Authority and the Prince Philip Dental Hospital after a two-week orientation.
A new intake of 78 graduates started the programme on 1 September. The department said the scheme helps address manpower needs in the public sector and provides structured clinical experience.

zh.headline: 首屆牙科實習計劃74人完成 46人加入衞生署
zh.dek: 約六成二畢業生選擇加入公營牙科服務，新一屆78名應屆生已於本月展開實習。
body: 衞生署周五表示，首屆強制牙科實習計劃有74名本地畢業生順利完成12個月實習並獲正式註冊，當中46人（約62%）將加入衞生署。
《牙醫註冊條例》相關條文於2025年4月生效，要求本地牙科畢業生須完成實習方可正式註冊。首批75人於2025年9月展開實習，其中一人因涉嫌未經授權閱覽病人紀錄而被延長實習期。
實習生先接受兩星期入職培訓，其後輪轉至全科、緊急、醫院、學童及社區牙科服務，服務單位包括衞生署、醫院管理局及菲臘牙科醫院。
新一屆共78名應屆畢業生已於9月1日展開實習。署方指計劃有助紓緩公營人手壓力，並為畢業生提供有系統的臨床經驗。
